en-US.author: VOVSOFT
en-US.description: Vovsoft Rich Text Editor is a user-friendly app for clutter-free text editing. Seamlessly open, edit, and save DOCX, RTF, HTML, and Markdown files, or export to PDF.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Rich Text Editor is a user-friendly document editing application. The software provides a clean interface with standard text formatting, allowing users to easily adjust fonts, alignment, and insert media.

Key Features:

* Fonts: Adjust font type, size, text and background color, as well as apply standard styles like bold, italics, underline, and strikethrough.
* Images: Supports images. Rather than just showing you the code for an image, the software will automatically download and display the actual pictures in your document, making it much easier to read and edit web-based content.
* Drag and Drop: You can easily drag and drop a file from Windows Explorer, or drag and drop text from other apps directly into the workspace.
* Printing: Includes full print and print preview capabilities.
* Spelling Check: Features built-in spell checking that supports all installed dictionaries in Windows (red underlines beneath unrecognized words).
* Emojis: Fully supports inserting and displaying color emojis to add visual expression and personality to your documents.
* Zoom: Easily scale your document view to your preference by adjusting the zoom percentage, allowing for comfortable reading and detailed editing.
* Command Line: Open a file using a command line parameter for quick access.

The application provides broad compatibility, supporting the following file formats:
* DOCX (Microsoft Word)
* RVF (RichView Format)
* RTF (RichText Format)
* HTML (HyperText Markup Language)
* Markdown
* Text
* PDF (export only)
en-US.name: Vovsoft Rich Text Editor
